highlights.text: Ticking a Guardian Raid adds its average Lv1 gems to the gem total, by the character's item level.
A rested Guardian Raid counts double gems, like the game's double rewards.
The Gems page lists Guardian Raid with Ebony Cube and Haal's Hourglass. Luminous Gem Shards aren't counted.
A new app icon: a gold gem on the exe, in the tray and on the browser tab.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Ticking and unticking quickly no longer leaves the box showing the wrong state.

highlights.text: Pasting your roster from lostark.bible now works: it reads each name and item level.
lostark.bible shows classes only as icons, so you pick each class from a list before adding.
Combat power and the other page text are skipped, and the highest item levels still become gold earners.
Paste a whole roster page (lostark.bible, say) in Settings: the other text on the page is skipped.
Reset everything (Settings → Backup & restore) starts over from scratch, with Undo.
Compact density is now clearly tighter, so more of the tracker fits on screen.

sections.title: Fixes
items: After an update, the browser always shows the new version straight away.

highlights.text: Raids clear gate by gate: tick G1 and G2 on their own, each paying its own gold, or the checkbox for both.
A raid with one gate's gold claimed uses one of your 3 paid raids, and its next gate can be run at another difficulty.
What's new: after an update, the new version's highlights show once. The version in the menu bar opens every release's notes.
On a phone, the first character's raids are on the first screen: a compact toolbar and top boxes.
LOA Logs import knows gates, so a gate 1 clear imports as gate 1.

sections.title: Fixes
items: A security update for the app's web framework, and the tracker loads less data.

highlights.text: Update now: the app updates itself from here on, and only installs releases signed by the developer.
Simpler top boxes: Gold this week (raids and other gold) and a new Dailies today.
Azena's and Inanna's blessings per character. With Inanna's, Chaos Dungeon has two runs a day.
Log fate and blessed embers from Chaos Dungeon and Guardian Raid (Customize → Today).
The Endgame Content badge above every raid, bigger class icons and new game icons.
Ebony Cube ticket chips right in the cell, and Sands of Trial as 0-5.

sections.title: Also new
items: A Today at a glance strip: next resets, gold raids left and reminders.
Hover a raid's name for each difficulty's item level, gold, bound split and bonus box cost.
Copy What's left as an image for Discord (made on your computer, nothing uploaded).
Filter characters by name or class on big rosters.
A bottom menu bar on phones, and placeholders instead of blank spots while loading.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Other websites can no longer send changes to the tracker.
One clear focus ring, labelled Settings fields and keyboard-readable help.
Rows no longer shift when the All button disappears, and rest gauges no longer overlap on narrow screens.

highlights.text: Game icons: class emblems beside every name, and item icons for gold, gems and the Ebony Cube.
First-run setup: pick how much to track, add your characters and choose your gold earners.
Bigger text, with Settings → Appearance for text size and density.
Raid values come with each update, checked against the patch notes.
Optional Field Boss and Chaos Gate drop logging on their days.

sections.title: Also new
items: The astrogem tool looks like the game's Processing window.
Growth Boost Shop: a weekly checkbox per character.
Customize has Save and Cancel; rearranging the page has its own Done button.
Item levels are coloured by the best raid tier they reach.

sections.title: Changes
items: The Raids page, the honing planner and the Prices tool are gone; Guides links the honing calculators.
The gold goal counts tradeable gold, or tradeable + roster-bound.

highlights.text: The new-week recap shows where last week's gold and gems came from.
A Review link by the gold earner count opens the suggested gold setup.
Pages show a placeholder of their layout while loading.
Each tracker widget says in one line what it's for.
GOLD beside each name toggles gold earners (6 per account).
Character-bound gold is kept apart and set per character.
The gold goal can count tradeable gold, tradeable + roster-bound, or one character.
Rearrange the tracker's blocks and widgets.
An auction calculator on the tracker, and an astrogem panel laid out like the game's.
